items.description: Use esta tanga de cintura alta perfectamente elástica y moldeadora para lograr un abdomen plano y una cintura ceñida sin volumen ni líneas de bragas. items.name: SKIMS ULTIMATE TEARDROP PUSH-UP BRA | CLAY
items.description: Ultimate Bra redefine los sujetadores push-up tradicionales al mejorar la forma natural de tu busto y transformar completamente la apariencia, la forma y la plenitud de tu busto. Este sujetador está hecho de un tejido de microfibra brillante súper suave con alas laterales extra compresivas para suavizar.
items.description_en: The Ultimate Bra redefines traditional push-up bras by enhancing your natural bust shape and completely transforming the look, shape, and fullness of your bust. This bra is made of a super soft sheen microfiber fabric with extra compressive side wings for smoothing. With a comfortable, concealed underwire and premium teardrop shaped foam pads, this bra sits seamlessly under clothing . Designed for a snug fit. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up one band size.

items.name: SKIMS ULTIMATE BALCONETTE PUSH-UP BRA | CLAY
items.description: Trabajo de senos instantáneo. Actualizado con un escote recto para combinar con estilos de cuello redondo, nuestro viral Ultimate Bra redefine el push-up tradicional levantando, realzando y amplificando tu busto natural para un escote dramáticamente más completo.
items.description_en: Instant boob job. Updated with a straight neckline for pairing with scoop neck styles, our viral Ultimate Bra redefines the traditional push-up by lifting, enhancing, and amplifying your natural bust for dramatically fuller cleavage. Crafted from super-soft sheen microfiber with smoothing side wings, this solution features a comfortable concealed underwire and premium foam pads designed to maximize lift and fullness. Designed for a snug fit. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up one band size.

items.name: SKIMS ULTIMATE STRAPLESS PUSH-UP BRA | CLAY
items.description: Forma, elevación y ajuste perfectos: nuestro revolucionario Ultimate Bra ahora cuenta con correas convertibles y removibles para un estilo versátil y múltiples formas de usarlo. Diseñado para realzar tu busto y lograr un escote máximo, este sujetador push-up cuenta con almohadillas de espuma increíblemente livianas que levantan y amplifican tu forma natural para lograr curvas más completas y definidas.
items.description_en: Perfect shape, lift, and fit—our revolutionary Ultimate Bra now features convertible, removable straps for versatile styling and multiple ways to wear. Designed to enhance your bust for maximal cleavage, this push-up bra features incredibly lightweight foam pads that lift and amplify your natural shape for fuller, more defined curves. Crafted from super-soft sheen microfiber with an elastic wing engineered for advanced smoothing and support, the band is intentionally designed to fit snugly for maximum lift and to stay securely in place. Finished with a concealed, cushioned underwire for comfortable support that won’t dig or pinch. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up one band size.

items.name: SEAMLESS SCULPT BRIEF BODYSUIT | ONYX
items.description: Nuestro body esculpidor viral, actualizado para un ajuste aún mejor. Este estilo que realza la figura tiene compresión adicional en el centro y la cintura, líneas de estilo perfectamente ubicadas que realzan tu busto y bolsillos traseros redondeados para una apariencia levantada.
items.description_en: Our viral sculpting bodysuit , updated for an even better fit. This figure-enhancing style has extra compression at the core and waist, perfectly placed style lines that flatter your bust, and rounded butt pockets for a lifted look. Features adjustable straps, a wide crotch for added coverage, and a cotton gusset with snap closure. Fits true to size.

items.name: SEAMLESS SCULPT STRAPLESS SHORTIE BODYSUIT | CLAY
items.description: Esta solución de shorty sin tirantes es perfecta para ceñir la cintura, sujetar la barriga y el centro y suavizar los muslos debajo de minifaldas y vestidos. Cuenta con costuras de piqué que sostienen tu busto, un refuerzo abierto y correas ajustables removibles que puedes usar como correas para los hombros, cruzadas en la espalda o como cabestro.
items.description_en: This strapless shortie solution is perfect for cinching your waist, holding in your tummy and core, and smoothing your thighs under mini skirts and dresses. Features pique stitching that supports your bust, an open gusset, and removable adjustable straps that you can wear as shoulder straps, cross back, or as a halter.

items.name: SEAMLESS SCULPT THONG BODYSUIT | ONYX
items.description: El body esculpidor favorito de Internet, actualizado para un ajuste aún mejor. Este estilo ceñido a la cintura mejora tu forma con compresión adicional en el centro y la cintura y tiene líneas de estilo perfectamente ubicadas que realzan tu busto.
items.description_en: The internet’s favorite sculpting bodysuit , updated for an even better fit. This waist-cinching style enhances your shape with extra compression at the core and waist and has perfectly placed style lines that flatter your bust. Features adjustable straps, a wide crotch for added coverage, and an open gusset with snap closure. Fits true to size.

items.name: SKIMS BODY CORE SCULPT HIGH-WAISTED SHORT | CLAY
items.description: Tu atajo para tener un abdomen tonificado. Diseñada con compresión central esculpida, esta solución de cintura alta encoge tu cintura hasta dos pulgadas mientras que nuestro exclusivo tejido SKIMS Body da forma a tus muslos y glúteos.
items.description_en: Your shortcut to a toned tummy. Designed with sculpting core compression, this high-waisted solution shrinks your waist up to two inches while our signature SKIMS Body fabric shapes your thighs and butt. Features an open gusset, interior bonded elastic along the waist, and raw cut leg openings for a seamless look under clothing. Hits at the mid-thigh.

Also available in petite sizes .
